purpose: Test whether per-type change features improve next-30-day K% and BB% forecasts beyond a matched baseline with the same current pitch measurements and results history. Development seasons only.
gap: Outcome windows end inside their own season, so no training outcome window crosses a test-season cutoff.

linear_models.B: Original B: results history plus current pitch characteristics and usage.
linear_models.V: B plus the original fastball velocity change (chg_fb_velo); the simple velocity-change baseline.
linear_models.C: Original C: B plus every original pitch-group change feature. Reference only.
linear_models.P: B plus the per-type change features below. The central comparison is P versus B.

per_type_features.pt_fb_velo: Shrunk velocity change of the primary fastball (FF, SI or FA with the most baseline usage).
per_type_features.pt_fb_ivb: Shrunk vertical movement change of the primary fastball.
per_type_features.pt_fb_hb: Shrunk arm-side movement change of the primary fastball.
per_type_features.pt_other_velo: Baseline-usage-weighted shrunk velocity change across non-fastball types.
per_type_features.pt_other_move: Baseline-usage-weighted mean of |shrunk hb change| + |shrunk ivb change| across non-fastball types.
per_type_features.pt_usage_shift: Half the summed absolute usage change across all types, including unknown labels.
per_type_features.pt_new_usage: Recent usage of types absent from the baseline window.
per_type_features.pt_max_z: Largest |shrunk physical change| / sqrt(prior variance); the review-list score.

per_type_support: Physical features need a known label, both windows, and at least two outings with the type in each window; otherwise missing.
shrinkage: Noise variance from the saved 95% outing-bootstrap interval, ((high - low) / 3.92)^2. Zero-centered prior per metric and pitch type, mean(delta^2 - noise variance) clipped at zero, fitted on the fold's training seasons only; metric pool when fewer than two training pitchers. Features use no outcomes.
linear_tuning: Inverse regularization C from [0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0], chosen by log loss on the inner validation season, then refit on all training seasons.

nonlinear.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier on binomial counts (two weighted rows per forecast).
nonlinear.comparison: NB (B features) versus NP (P features), same tuning budget.
nonlinear.tuning: max_iter from [100, 200, 400], chosen on the inner validation season. Six candidate fits per model, target and fold; no further tuning.

repertoire_fallback: Original rule, fitted per fold on eligible training rows: forecasts outside observed training usage ranges use model A for every compared model.
scoring: Binomial log loss per batter faced over rows with follow-up; rows without follow-up reported, not scored.
uncertainty: Pitcher-cluster bootstrap, 1000 draws, on pooled 2023-2024 test rows; also per fold.
directional: Among scored rows, BF-weighted share where the change model's move away from B points toward the observed rate.
subgroups: Exploratory: starters (start_share >= 0.5) versus relievers; forecasts with versus without a supported primary-fastball change.
stop_rule: Run once. Report every comparison regardless of direction. Do not add features or tuning after seeing results. No 2025 or 2026 rows are read.
